about.text: The most important cheese of the canton of Uri by weight: a semi-hard alp cheese of 6 to 8 kg with sparse holes, sold mild, savoury or mature. As with all Alpkäse, it is made from raw milk of cows grazing freely on an alp in the season.

sources.text: Its weight, holes, forms and the Alpkäse rules, from the article.
